title: S60 — Verify: canonical-suite source identity (regenerate + match committed dir hashes)
desc: NEW-OP STARTER. GOAL: regenerate the canonical suites from scratch and prove the committed dir_hashes still match: seed-1 b2c460d2fb5a…, seed-2 ec64cd63…, plus any other suite under data/ with a recorded hash. WHY: everything rests on 'same bytes, same scores' — cheapest independent trust check in the repo. READ FIRST: BENCH.md (suite format); tools/make_suites.py; tools/s38_compare.py. STEPS: fresh clone; regen each suite at its seed; compute dir_hash with the committed tool; compare; document any mismatch with file-level diff evidence. EVIDENCE: reports/source-identity/<date>.md (hash table + exact commands) + PUSHES row + formalcode line. BOUNDARIES: read-only except your report; mismatches are groupchatcode findings. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
